prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and background-extraction.
Asset: standalone bottommost human-body terrain layer for a cute geometric cell-battle game.
INPUT IMAGE 1 is the EDIT TARGET and EXACT composition/geometry reference. INPUT IMAGE 2 is STYLE ONLY, showing the accepted warm pastel matte beveled geometric game-map finish; do not add kidney objects from image 2.
Extract and refine ONLY the body silhouette + muscle/soft-tissue ground + EXISTING bones/joints. DELETE ALL internal organs from image 1: brain, both lungs and their blue trees, liver/gallbladder, stomach, pancreas, kidneys, intestines, bladder. DELETE the big irregular cream placeholder over the chest and every superficial blood vessel, green remnant, pipe and duct; these all belong to independent upper layers. Repair those footprints with continuous warm peach/coral/pink low-relief muscle/soft-tissue ground. No organ-shaped cutout holes or transparent holes inside the body. Leave background OUTSIDE the body genuinely transparent, including gaps between fingers, legs and between arms and torso.
Geometry is LOCKED: retain exact 1024:1536 framing, same image margins, body pose, head/ear shape, torso proportions, arm angles, hand/finger positions, pelvis, leg/foot/toe contours. Do not rotate, mirror, recenter, change body proportions or spread limbs. Existing cream bones and round joints in shoulders, upper/lower arms, wrists/hands, pelvis, thighs/knees, shins, ankles/feet and the upper central neck vertebrae must retain their exact positions, lengths, widths and main silhouettes. Do not invent ribs, new skull/facial bones, new spine, extra anatomy, a character face or visible genitals. The old two face/socket-like orange ovals can become warm softly inset tissue color patches, never eyes or holes.
Refinement: slightly more polished CUTE GEOMETRIC ANIME GAME TERRAIN, clean thin warm terracotta contours, softly rounded polygon facets, matte two/three-tone cel shading, restrained shallow cream bevels on bones and small soft contact shadows. Muscles read as flowing flat bundles of softly elongated peach/rose polygon patches following the EXISTING limb/torso directions, with finer warm cell-like chips and short subtle fiber facets, not vein-like streaks. Bones read as friendly ivory solid geometric landforms, not realistic skeleton horror. Keep the ground readable and calm, detailed but not busy; similar softness/detail balance to image 2. Preserve local source colors (warm peach/coral tissue, ivory bones), harmonious and fresh, no green and no blue vessel lines.
Absolutely no worms, tentacles, pores, perforated dots, slime, exposed wet flesh, scary skull, realistic dissection, faces/eyes/characters, text, labels, UI, weapons, flowers or unrelated new obstacles. Only the isolated bottom body layer. High native detail, requested 2048x3072 or highest available portrait resolution. Exact original framing and major shapes; only clean unwanted upper-layer content and improve drawing style.
